title: Utility Pass-Through Service Billing Calendar, Administration Fee and Final-Statement Timing
content:
The monthly cycle of the Utility Pass-Through Service runs on fixed days set by each service schedule. This reference gives the read day, the statement day, the due period, the administration fee and the timing figures for the final statement on every schedule.

## Calendar and fee figures

| Service schedule | Meter read day (day of month) | Statement day (day of month) | Payment due (calendar days after statement date) | Administration fee (USD per statement) | Final statement issued within (calendar days after final read) | Collections referral after (calendar days after final statement due date) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Flat-Rate Water, Sewer & Trash Schedule | not applicable (no meter reads) | 1 | 20 | 0.00 | 10 | 60 |
| Submetered Water Schedule | 22 | 1 | 20 | 3.25 | 10 | 60 |
| Submetered Water & Sewer Schedule | 25 | 1 | 20 | 3.25 | 10 | 60 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Natural Gas Schedule | 20 | 1 | 20 | 3.95 | 10 | 60 |
| Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule | 18 | 1 | 20 | 3.95 | 10 | 60 |
| Submetered Electric, Water & Sewer Schedule | 24 | 1 | 20 | 4.50 | 10 | 60 |

## Rounding and proration (all six schedules)

- **Rounding of amounts**: each computed charge and credit is rounded half up to the cent.
- **Proration basis**: fixed monthly charges in the opening and final billing periods are prorated on the actual days in the period.

## Definitions

- **Meter read day**: the day of the month on which the community reads every submeter.
- **Statement day**: the day of the month on which the utility statement for the prior read cycle is issued — or, on the flat-rate schedule, the statement for the current month.
- **Payment due**: the number of calendar days after the statement date on which the statement is due.
- **Administration fee**: the billing and administration fee added to each monthly statement.
- **Final statement timing**: the number of calendar days after the final read within which the final statement is issued.
- **Collections referral period**: the number of calendar days after the final statement's due date after which an unpaid final balance is referred to collections.

## Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A statement dated on the 1st of a month with a 20-day due period is due on the 21st of that month. On the Submetered Water, Sewer & Propane Schedule, the read taken on the 18th of one month is billed on the statement dated the 1st of the following month.
